title: Easy to install,  but fragile
text: Easy to install,  but fragile. I thought this would add extra storage in our RV - free up the cabinet with my ridiculously oversized spice collection.  Its light enough for an RV installation  and super simple  with just 4 screws to attach. Unfortunately, the pieces are very thin and prone to cracking. The support rails that hold the screws cracked twice as I put it up. I was using a handheld screwdriver, not a drill. I'm using the shelf, but for the boxes of Advantix and Heartgard for the dogs instead of heavier spice bottles.
